  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Sales">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="SendTask_Quote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_Confirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales and Order Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Inquiry" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns or questions"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested_Split" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Quote" name="Send quote to customer" messageRef="Msg_Quote"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Approval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Approval" messageRef="Msg_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Confirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interested_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="SendTask_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_Quote" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Approval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="SendTask_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_Confirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a step is performed only if a condition holds, introduced by a conditional phrase such as 'If ..., they are ...' or 'If ..., the process ...': Model an exclusive gateway immediately before that conditional step. Give it one outgoing sequence flow to the conditional step and one to the alternative path, which may skip to a later point or end the process. Route both branches back into the main flow with an exclusive join where they reconverge.
rules.situation: the description states that a step is performed only if a condition holds, introduced by a conditional phrase such as 'If ..., they are ...' or 'If ..., the process ...'

rules.instruction: When the description states that a later step is performed only if a stated condition holds, using an 'if ... then' phrasing that gates that step on a decision made earlier in the process: Model an exclusive gateway immediately before the gated step, with one outgoing branch that leads to the gated step under the stated condition and another branch that skips it or leads to the process's alternative path. Keep the gateway after the activity that establishes the condition, so the decision is evaluated in the order the description gives.
